annotations.title: List the documents a file feeds

description: List the documents that include a file or whose embeds and queries read it - the pages a change to it moves. Use it before editing, moving or deleting a document, data file or query file; it does not list links, so for what links to a document query folio.links with folio_query. Answers {ready, documents: [{source, how: includes or embeds}]}; ready false, with no documents, while Folio still reads the folder. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

path.description: The file's path, relative to the served folder or absolute under it: a document, data file or .sql file, such as data/daily.csv
